bestBets.overview: OZONICA was heavily backed when leading and bolting in first up. He'll only be improved, again looks the likely leader and can repeat. GLORY MISSION resumes from a long break but has won both lead-in trials and looked progressive when last in work. Former Victorian WILD DANCER disappointed last start but has been freshened since and was successful at two of his first three local outings. OUTBUSH was dominant two starts ago before fading from on pace last time.

raceTips.comment: Ozonica won in incredible style first up producing a career best rating. He looks very progressive and should be in for a big Spring. He should just be winning before progressing to stronger races. Glory Mission has been very consistent of late and did trial well. Wild Dancer has place claims.

bestBets.overview: OUT OF THE SPHERE was specked at big odds and battled away gamely after sitting outside the leader/victor fresh. He may be a genuine improver this time in. JOCK ROCK was only narrowly denied at his first appearance and will be better for the experience. FLYING FURTHER loomed and peaked on the run when specked at healthy odds on debut and will strip fitter now. The debutante BLUE RENDEZVOUS was placed in a recent trial here and any positive market moves should be respected.

raceTips.comment: Jock Rock was only narrowly beaten on debut when rundown late. This looks a very winnable race on paper, given that he should prove hard to beat with the visors on. Blue Rendezvous has shown ability at the trials. Flying Further should run an improved race now fitter.

bestBets.overview: Former Victorian mare LYREBIRD LADY has been game in defeat at both her local outings and shouldn't remain a maiden much longer. SHINES DISCREETLY faded after leading on the Pakenham synthetic last start and is still to be placed from 8 attempts but his Cranbourne based trainer has a great record down here. GYM PRINCESS worked home soundly over this route second up before perhaps not quite seeing out 1880m last time. HIGHLAND DASH was disappointing at her local debut but can only be improved.

raceTips.comment: Lyrebird Lady looks ready to win now fully fit third up. She is very well placed and is the horse to beat. She should be winning here. Shines Discreetly best is good enough here and will find this easier then racing in Victoria. Sir William will give a sight on speed.

bestBets.overview: JOHNNIE PINCH was disappointing at his second run back from a freshen but was again sound last time. He's only missed a place once from five tries on synthetic and is nicely in at the weights after the claim. AL MAXIMUS stormed home from the back to score over this route last start and should again be strong when it counts. EAGLEFURTHER was only worn down last after leading last week and can be in this for a long way as well. FLOSSING tired late after sitting outside her but may benefit from a quieter ride.

raceTips.comment: Eaglefurther should get favours on speed here and looks to bring in the best recent form. She should be hard to rundown. Al Maximus found the line in good style when winning last start. Flossing has place claims at odds.

bestBets.overview: ALPINE WOLF sat too far back at his only run last term and usually comes to hand quickly. He's been given a nice, quiet lead-in trial and if they overdo it up front he can get over them late. HARTMAN stalked THOROS OF MYR before wearing him down in track record time fresh and both of those on-pacers should run boldly again. TSUNAMI SAM went too hard up front third up but has been freshened since and had been game in the placings at his first two runs this prep. CHEROKEE DANCER was just even fresh but plummets in weight and is proved second up.

raceTips.comment: Hartman was a dominant winner last start in fast time. He ran a career best rating on that occasion and should just be winning again if he holds his form. Tsunami Sam should roll forward and give a sight. Alpine Wolf looks the best chance of the backmarkers.

bestBets.overview: Speedy Victorian raider DISSALTO draws to advantage and should take plenty of catching if able to control the tempo. Keep him very safe at his local debut. GEEGEES MERCEDES was game in defeat here last time and maps to enjoy a nice trail just behind the leaders. PARTY DAY led and gave a good sight when resuming and will only be improved. EQUIVASTAR was warmly supported when clearing maiden ranks last start and may go on now that she's broken through.

raceTips.comment: Party Day is a progressive type that trialled super leading into her first up run where she was just rundown late. Now fitter she should be hard to beat here. Dissalto has been racing well in Victoria and should be right in the finish again. Geegees Mercedes now fully fit should be in the finish again.

bestBets.overview: Launceston Guineas placegetter WOLF JUNIOR was no match for the in-form Stardarmus when resuming but tried hard. He's the one to beat if not now looking for further. COLONEL BOGEY scored an overdue maiden win second up, then led and gave a good sight rising to this level off a freshen. Barry Campbell has a strong record with former Chris Waller representatives and any positive market moves on CAVARETTA must be respected. SNOWDONIA was better when weighing in third up and should now be at peak fitness.

raceTips.comment: Colonel Bogey brings in the strongest form chasing City Wok. He gets in well at the weights here after the claim. This looks a nice race for him. Wolf Junior ran well first up and should be improved here now fitter. Chef's Kiss has each way claims. Nandi Clan looks a touch over the odds at double figures.

bestBets.overview: AZONTO was given a gun run to score last week. She's got the outside gate to overcome this time but gets in light with the rise in grade and should be launching late. THE LONGEST YARD finished off hard to take the Golden Mile and on that performance the rise in trip shouldn't pose a problem. ZEWINNA was sound holding third position throughout in that race but is yet to prove herself beyond 1600m. HAPPY CLAN continues to find a win elusive this time in but he's honest and should be around the mark again.

raceTips.comment: Azonto is racing in great form and looks very well placed off 54.5kgs with C Newitt in the saddle. The Longest Yard won in good style last week and looks well placed here. Merlin Beach may want further but is very consistent and should be in the finish.

bestBets.overview: THE SPIRIT OF ZERO found the line nicely at this track at his first two runs this prep before failing to threaten on turf third up. He's got a hefty impost but looks well placed back in grade and the return to synthetic is a positive. I'M CHEV worked home soundly behind a dominant all-the-way victor fresh and was again good to the line second up. COOL HEART has been sound at all three runs this time in and strips hard fit for them. THISISMYTURF is unknown on synthetic and was never likely last time but had looked close to another win prior.

raceTips.comment: I'm Chev ran a great race first up, then was just too far back last start. Rising in distance here looks a big positive for him. Thisismyturf is racing well and will be strong late from back in the field. The Spirit Of Zero struggles to win but will be another who'll be very strong late.
